jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Certificate Authority
jobs.description_text: Available Locations: Austin or London About the Role TLS is the connective tissue of the Internet, and Cloudflare terminates a large fraction of it. Cloudflare sits in front of more than 20 percent of global Internet request traffic and terminates TLS for millions of domains. Every day, our network handles certificate operations across products like Universal SSL, SSL for SaaS, Origin CA, Cloudflare Access, and Cloudflare Tunnel. That scale has taught us how the WebPKI ecosystem works from the consuming side. As certificate lifetimes shorten, agentic activity increases, and post-quantum certificates move toward production, the number of certificates the Internet depends on will grow dramatically. Cloudflare is building a certificate authority for the whole Internet: a public, redundant, transparent CA that provides another trusted source of automated certificates and helps make the encrypted web more resilient. We intend to be ACME-first, automation-first, and transparent by design. We also intend to lead where the ecosystem is going, including post-quantum certificates and Merkle Tree Certificates, while continuing to support the classic WebPKI customers rely on today. As Principal Product Manager for Cloudflare's Certificate Authority business, you will define the product strategy, roadmap, customer experience, and commercial model for this new venture. You will work across product, engineering, security, compliance, legal, operations, sales, marketing, and the WebPKI ecosy

jobs.title: Senior Certificate Authority Architect
jobs.description_text: Cloudflare is building a new public Certificate Authority for the Internet. We are looking for a senior technical architect to help define the systems, protocols, and security architecture behind it. This role spans applied cryptography, Web PKI, distributed systems, security engineering, compliance, and Internet standards. It will help Cloudflare build a CA that operates safely at Internet scale while establishing a credible path from today's X.509 ecosystem toward post-quantum authentication using Merkle Tree Certificates (MTCs). Mission Define and guide the end-to-end architecture of Cloudflare's public Certificate Authority: a high-assurance, highly available system capable of issuing conventional publicly trusted certificates at Cloudflare scale while supporting Merkle Tree Certificates (MTCs) and the evolution toward a post-quantum Web PKI. You will help determine not only how the CA is implemented, but also its trust boundaries, key hierarchy, issuance architecture, auditability, failure modes, incident response mechanisms, and long-term cryptographic evolution. Key Responsibilities Define and maintain the end-to-end technical architecture of Cloudflare's public CA across certificate issuance, key management, transparency, revocation, renewal, and relying-party integration. jobs.description_text: Locations: Austin, Lisbon, San Francisco, NYC, or London About the Role Search is being rebuilt around AI. People increasingly get answers from AI instead of a list of links, agents run dozens of searches to answer a single question, and more than half of the traffic reaching sites on Cloudflare is now automated . Search is shifting from a destination to a utility, and Cloudflare is building the search layer for this agentic Internet. Agentic Search at Cloudflare gives agents everything they need to find information, whether it lives in a customer’s own data or on the open web. It spans two products: AI Search for internal data, and Web Search API for the open web. AI Search (internal data), now generally available , is the search primitive for applications and agents . It is a fully managed indexing and retrieval pipeline built on Workers AI , Vectorize , R2 , and Browser Run . Developers connect a website or R2 bucket, or upload their own files, and query them with natural language through a Workers binding, REST API, or MCP server. Under the hood: continuous indexing, hybrid vector and keyword retrieval, reranking, metadata filtering, native multimodal (image) embeddings, and OCR for scanned documents. We use it to power search on our own blog and developer docs. Web Search API (external data), now in open beta , gives agents real-time web context with a single API call. It runs on AI Gateway , so every search gets the same logging, analytics, billing, and access controls

AI models are trained and grounded on the web, but they have little visibility into what's changed, what's authoritative, or what's been fabricated. Site owners have it worse: AI crawlers already request content anywhere from a hundred to tens of thousands of times for every visitor they send back, and most have no idea how, or whether, they show up in AI answers. Both sides of the market are flying blind. Cloudflare sits in front of around 20% of the web and sees both sides of that exchange. Our team, the Agentic Internet team, is focused on making the web readable, discoverable, callable, and payable, built on open standards so no single company owns the rails. jobs.description_text: Available Locations: Austin or London (Hybrid) About the Role We're hiring the first Dashboard & Configuration Product Manager Cloudflare's Web Integrity & Trust product suite. More than 50% of Internet traffic is automated. Knowing who's human, who's an agent, and who's a malicious actor is core to Cloudflare's strategy, and one of the primary values we sell to our customers.Cloudflare sits in front of more than 20% of the web. That vantage point lets us detect automated threats, fraud, and traffic manipulation at a scale and depth no one else can match. Turning that raw signal into something a human can understand, trust, and act on is one of the most interesting design problems in security today — and it's the problem you'll own. Our products make probabilistic decisions in an adversarial environment. “Is this traffic truthfully representing who they are?” and "Can we trust this traffic?" doesn't have a clean yes-or-no answer. Our objective is to minimize risk without ever having ground truth. You will set the technical direction for how we source, ingest, model, and serve new data assets, and you will be responsible for designing, building, and scaling the data models, pipelines, and architecture that power business performance impacting decisions for data scientists, analysts, and traders. The first year of this work will be scrappy and hands-on, spanning real-time data ingestion, building scrapers, and standing up a medallion architecture from the ground up. We will start with NBA and NFL, which have relatively solid data foundations, before pivoting to an international soccer model that will require a significantly heavier lift. Beyond the build, you will be expected to raise the bar for the broader team, mentoring other analytics engineers and driving improvements to our engineering best practices, standards, and ways of working. This is a great opportunity for a seasoned engineer who thrives in an environment where curiosity is rewarded and people are empowered to make decisions. The ideal candidate will have a passion for learning, a bias toward action, and a desire to shape how we leverage our data at scale. THE GAME PLAN Everyone on our team has a part to play Arc

jobs.description_text: About this role: Our Engineering organization owns the software that makes our marketplace work. The Data Platform group supports everyone at Faire who depends on data: Product Engineering, Data Science, Machine Learning, Analytics, Strategy, Finance, and Product. Our job is to make sure the data is there, it's right, and people can find it and query it without having to think about the plumbing underneath. We are hiring a Staff Engineer to own that plumbing. Concretely, this means the path data takes out of our production databases (CockroachDB and MySQL) and into a place where analysts and data scientists can query it. Today that involves Fivetran, Kafka, Spark, and Airflow landing data in Snowflake and Databricks. It works, but it grew up over time and it shows. We want someone who can design the next version of it, build the hard parts personally, and bring the rest of the company along. This is a hands-on role. You'll also be the person other teams come to when they need to know how data should move at Faire. What you'll do: Set the technical direction for how data moves from production systems into our analytical stores, and own the roadmap to get there over the next couple of years. Build the CDC and streaming ingestion layer: CockroachDB changefeeds and MySQL binlogs into Kafka, then into Iceberg tables on S3. This role will support an expanding retail portfolio and lead omnichannel investigations across retail, e-commerce, fulfilment, and supply chain operations in both markets. You will also partner with the department responsible for Health & Safety to support workplace safety initiatives. Working closely with corporate teams and external partners, the Senior Accountant will help ensure accurate and timely financial reporting, maintain effective controls, and improve accounting processes. Analyze financial results and prepare variance analyses to support management reporting. Assist in the preparation of monthly and annual financial statements and related disclosures. Maintain effective internal controls and ensure adherence to Korean tax regulations, company accounting policies, and group financial policies. Support external audits by preparing audit schedules and responding to auditor inquiries. Lead initiatives to improve accounting processes, strengthen controls, and enhance operational efficiency. As a Developer Advocate at Fireworks, you own a piece of that decision: you make Fireworks the platform developers reach for first when they want to build, fine-tune, and serve frontier open models in production. You are a working engineer: you ship code, read diffs, deploy models, and can hold your own in a conversation about batching, quantization, or why a fine-tune regressed. You are also a public technical communicator: you write clearly enough that a senior engineer forwards it, you're good on a stage, and you have or want a real presence in the places developers actually argue about this stuff. Most people are strong at one and passable at the other. We're looking for the rarer profile who is genuinely credible at both, because in AI infrastructure the audience can tell within one paragraph whether you've actually run the thing. The field moves weekly. A major open-weights model drops and the window to be the definitive resource on it is measured in days. jobs.description_text: The Role: Make data a solved problem for every GPU workload at Fireworks. We own how data is stored, cached and moved across clouds, so that training and inference teams never have to think about where their data lives or how it gets to them, and no GPU ever waits on it. Datasets, checkpoints, model weights and KV cache should be in the right place at the right time, at whatever scale the GPUs need. Training jobs start without a data-staging step, inference replicas cold-start without waiting on weight downloads, and the system handles placement, replication and movement on its own. jobs.description_text: P-1096 At Databricks, we run the world's largest AI platform. We believe the next breakthroughs will come from models trained on domain-specific enterprise data, not from bigger general-purpose models alone. That's why we built AI Runtime , a serverless product that makes GPU training of any size feel simple, so companies can train their own models the way frontier labs do. Customers across industries train on it, right next to the enterprise data already in Databricks. Among them are Rivian in automotive, Robinhood in fintech, and Merck, which builds foundation models for drug discovery. Our own AI researchers use it to post-train models with hundreds of billions to nearly a trillion parameters. It takes a lot of engineering to make that work, and we've written about it on our blog: how we keep GPUs reliable , make training fault-tolerant , and speed up fine-tuning with fused kernels and smart sequence packing. AI agents now launch experiments too, and on our research team they've already increased training jobs 8x . As a Senior Staff Software Engineer, you'll work on the systems behind all of this, solving the hardest technical problems and shaping where AI Runtime goes next. The impact you will have: Drive AI Runtime's architecture and lead Databricks' long-term technical direction in AI training infrastructure.
